comment: Single source of truth for the xmedia-bridge line protocol. Consumed by TS (protocol.ts, imported directly) and by C++ (engine/src/xmedia_protocol.h, generated by product/xmedia/scripts/gen-protocol.mjs). Do NOT hand-edit the generated header — edit this file and re-run the generator. INDEX SEMANTICS: request/response arrays list PAYLOAD columns only, so index i means the (i+1)-th tab-separated field on the wire — field 0 is always the framing token ('<verb>' for hello/ping, 'ok' for ok-framed replies).
